name: Anime still collage
summary: A still from a 1980s or 1990s anime, cropped and set on a sunset gradient with dots, katakana and small stickers.
how: Crop one still or cel from a 1980s or 1990s anime to fill 60% to 80% of the width.
Set a pink to peach to teal gradient behind the still.
Add a dot screen of 6px to 10px at 10% to 15% opacity and a katakana line at half the size of the title.

origin.note: The Vaporwave article names the 2013 Sailorwave series of Macross 82-99 as the start of future funk, which draws on 1980s and 1990s anime.

adoptions.via: Future funk releases take their pictures from 1980s and 1990s anime such as Sailor Moon and Macross.
